items.title: File Newark employer payroll tax returns
items.authority: City of Newark Department of Finance
items.description: Employers with payroll in Newark register with the city and file quarterly returns for the 1% employer payroll tax.

items.title: Hold a Paterson mercantile license
items.description: City ordinance requires businesses operating in Paterson to register and obtain a mercantile license; operating a business, trade or occupation without one is prohibited.
